frontlist.title: When do new titles join the Digital Reading Shelf?
frontlist.body: New titles are released first as print books and single-copy e-books. After 90–180 days they join the Digital Reading Shelf, so Professional & Academic Society members can read them at no extra cost. The shelf date is shown on every digital product page.
frontlist.step1: At release: print book and single-copy e-book
frontlist.step2: 90–180 days later: joins the Digital Reading Shelf
frontlist.step3: After that: still available as a single copy

shelf.q: What is the Digital Reading Shelf?
shelf.a: A digital reading shelf of CakraNexa e-books and audiobooks that Professional & Academic Society and Author Guild members can access without buying each title.

frontlist.q: Why don't new titles join the shelf right away?
frontlist.a: New titles are sold as single copies first so authors are paid fairly. After 90–180 days a title joins the shelf, and the date is shown on its product page.

unitPurchase.q: Can I buy an e-book without a membership?
unitPurchase.a: Yes. Every available e-book and audiobook can be bought as a single copy and stays in My Library.

billing.q: What is the difference between monthly and annual billing?
billing.a: Annual billing is paid once a year at the price of 10 months, so you save 2 months compared with monthly billing.

cancel.q: Can I cancel at any time?
cancel.a: Yes. You can cancel at any time and your membership stays active until the end of the period you paid for. Titles bought as single copies remain yours.

institutions.q: I represent a university or library. Which plan fits?
institutions.a: Institution & Library Network: shared access for many users on an annual contract. Request a quote on the institutions page.

wallet.title: What is an acquisition wallet?
wallet.body: Part of the annual contract value is kept as an acquisition balance. It is used to buy selected titles permanently, so the collection stays with the institution even if the contract is not renewed.
